headline: I have spent more than 9 years building and maintaining web platforms in C# and .NET across travel, healthcare and construction. about: I am a full-stack .NET developer based in Metro Manila. For more than 9 years I have built and maintained web platforms in C# and .NET for travel, healthcare and construction.
My work began in 2017 with a desktop application in C# and Dapper. It has since grown into ASP.NET Core web platforms, an Umbraco content platform and the Vue.js front end that sits on top of them.
